title: Hold while a recent bid change is still inside validation
scenario: A keyword bid was increased yesterday and early conversion data is immature. The current request asks whether to cut the bid because no new orders have appeared yet.

forbidden_behaviors: Immediately reverse the bid because one immature day has no attributed orders.
Treat proposed or applied history as proof that the business outcome has failed.
required_observations: A recent bid change is still within its declared validation window.
Conversion attribution is not mature enough for a failure verdict.
No safety guardrail currently justifies overriding the hold.

rubric.requirement: Read the recent optimization event before recommending another bid change.
Prefer Hold/observe over a contradictory immediate reversal.
